text: The purpose of this report is to request exemptions from the Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 636 "Public Squares" and from the former City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 237 “Nathan Phillips Square” for events that are proposed to be held on Nathan Phillips Square from March 1, 2023 - August 31, 2023.
